about_the_game:
DispatchControl puts you in the hot seat of a modern emergency dispatch center. Your job is to answer incoming calls—ranging from routine transports to life-threatening emergencies—and coordinate the right units to the right locations.

Whether you’re handling a heart attack downtown or a fire in a rural area, your decisions matter. Each call comes with limited information, so you’ll need to ask the right questions, assess the urgency, and act fast.

Key Features:

  • Real-time Call Handling
    Take emergency calls and decide what help is needed—from ambulances to police and fire services.

  • Dynamic Map System
    Navigate a detailed world map using OpenStreetMap data, where locations, traffic, and geography affect your decisions.

  • Interactive UI Panels
    Organize calls, hold them for later, or assign them to your units—all with an intuitive drag-and-drop interface.

  • Customizable Incidents
    Create or import call scenarios for more depth and variety.

  • Realistic Priority Levels
    Triage based on urgency: life-threatening, urgent, or scheduled transports.

  • Voice Integration (Optional)
    Immersive voice lines and optional voice chat support for roleplay or multiplayer coordination.

Can you keep up with the chaos?

Manage stress, make life-saving decisions, and experience the pressure of a real emergency dispatcher.
